<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class WebhookVerificationController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Verify a webhook endpoint URL provided by the user.
     * Sends a challenge token to confirm ownership.
     */
    public function verify(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'callback_url' => 'required|url',
            'workspace_id' => 'required|string|max:64',
        ]);

        $callbackUrl = $request->input('callback_url');
        $workspaceId = $request->input('workspace_id');

        // Basic URL validation - block private IPs at parse time
        $parsed = parse_url($callbackUrl);
        $host = $parsed['host'] ?? '';
        
        if ($this->isPrivateHost($host)) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Private addresses not allowed'], 422);
        }

        // Resolve DNS to check for private IPs
        $resolved = gethostbyname($host);
        if ($this->isPrivateIP($resolved)) {
            Log::warning("Blocked private IP resolution", ['host' => $host, 'ip' => $resolved]);
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Host resolves to private address'], 422);
        }

        // Generate challenge token
        $challenge = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
        Cache::put("webhook_challenge:{$workspaceId}", $challenge, 300);

        // Send verification request to callback URL
        // DNS rebinding window: between resolution above and actual HTTP call below
        try {
            $response = Http::timeout(5)
                ->withHeaders([
                    'X-Webhook-Challenge' => $challenge,
                    'X-Workspace-Id' => $workspaceId,
                ])
                ->post($callbackUrl, [
                    'type' => 'url_verification',
                    'challenge' => $challenge,
                ]);

            if ($response->successful() && $response->json('challenge') === $challenge) {
                Cache::put("webhook_verified:{$workspaceId}", $callbackUrl, 86400);
                return response()->json(['status' => 'verified']);
            }

            return response()->json(['error' => 'Verification failed', 'status' => $response->status()], 400);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error("Webhook verification failed", ['url' => $callbackUrl, 'error' => $e->getMessage()]);
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Connection failed'], 502);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Fetch metadata from a verified webhook endpoint for display.
     */
    public function fetchMetadata(Request $request)
    {
        $workspaceId = $request->input('workspace_id');
        $verifiedUrl = Cache::get("webhook_verified:{$workspaceId}");

        if (!$verifiedUrl) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'No verified webhook'], 404);
        }

        // Fetch metadata from the already-verified URL
        // Second request is also vulnerable to rebinding since DNS may have changed
        $response = Http::timeout(3)->get(rtrim($verifiedUrl, '/') . '/metadata');
        
        return response()->json($response->json());
    }

    private function isPrivateHost(string $host): bool
    {
        if (in_array($host, ['localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1', '0.0.0.0'])) {
            return true;
        }
        if (preg_match('/\.local$/', $host)) {
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private function isPrivateIP(string $ip): bool
    {
        return !filter_var($ip, FILTER_VALIDATE_IP, 
            FILTER_FLAG_NO_PRIV_RANGE | FILTER_FLAG_NO_RES_RANGE);
    }
}

environment.description: Same Laravel 10 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate. The ALB listener on port 443 is configured with mutual TLS (mTLS) passthrough mode using a Trust Store associated with an internal PKI CA (arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:XXXX:certificate-authority/abc123). The listener's MutualAuthentication attribute is set with Mode=passthrough and TrustStoreArn pointing to the provisioned trust store. The ingress controller annotation `alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/mutual-authentication` is not used here — this is raw ALB API configuration via Terraform `aws_lb_listener` resource with `mutual_authentication { mode = "verify" trust_store_arn = "..." }`. Client connections without a valid certificate signed by the internal CA receive a 400 before reaching the application. The trust store contains only certificates issued to internal service mesh sidecars and authorized external partners with registered callback domains.

config.network: VPC with default security groups, no egress filtering
config.mtls_enforcement: ALB rejects connections at TLS handshake without valid client cert from internal CA
config.trust_store_policy: Only certs issued to service mesh sidecars and pre-registered partner domains
